species.tagline: A hammerhead with a smoother head edge

tasks.title: Compare the two hammers
tasks.message: Its head is smooth in front; the other kind has a notch in the middle.
tasks.subtitle: This is a hammerhead too, but the front of its head is smooth, with no notch.

tasks.title: How big it gets
tasks.message: A grown one can be as long as a car.
tasks.subtitle: A full-grown smooth hammerhead can be as long as a family car.

tasks.title: How to help
tasks.message: Clean seas are the only place a shark can live.
tasks.subtitle: Sharks need clean water and fish to eat. Thank you!
